summary: כֵּילַפּוֹת names axes or cutting tools in the sanctuary destruction scene.

senses.definition: Attackers smash the carved work together with hammer and cutting tool. The preceding verse pictures axes raised against a thicket.

note: Akkadian preserves the same tool and the k-l-p consonants. Hebrew occurs only in the plural, and the direction of borrowing is uncertain.

evidence.locator: armep, kalappu [pickaxe], x000025970, including the forms kalappāte and kalabbāti
